blocks.text: The encounter with the Canaanite woman holds together a sharp boundary and an unexpected response. Jesus describes his mission as directed to Israel and uses the image of children’s bread and dogs; the woman accepts the image but asks for the crumbs that fall from the table. Jesus then praises her faith, and her daughter is healed. The episode stands alongside Matthew’s wider portrayal of Jesus healing and casting out demons amid ancient understandings of bodies and spirits, while also placing an Israel-focused mission in tension with Matthew’s later movement toward all nations.
